evidence.label: mcp-js-prototype-pollution-merge-loop (medium/medium)
evidence.detail: Keys from a caller-supplied object are copied onto a target without excluding __proto__ / constructor / prototype. A tool argument carrying __proto__ then mutates Object.prototype for the whole process, which can turn an unrelated later property read into attacker-controlled data.

evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: stdio transport: the client launches the server as a subprocess, so the OS process boundary is the auth boundary — `03` §4 does not penalise absent auth here

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared transport: stdio — launched as a subprocess by the client, so the security boundary is the client process, not a network port (`03` §4)

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 17 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Base64 High Entropy String, Secret Keyword). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:1427; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:2062; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:2063; Secret Keyword at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:4529; Base64 High Entropy String at dist/cli-cmds.mjs:7526; Secret Keyword at dist/installer.mjs:13294; Base64 High Entropy String at dist/installer.mjs:16291; Secret Keyword at dist/installer.mjs:16576; Base64 High Entropy String at dist/mcp-server.mjs:14109; Secret Keyword at dist/mcp-server.mjs:16633; …and 7 more matches
